net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util

Class Query

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.util.Query

  • public final class Query
extends Object
    This class represents an immutable EoD-SQL query. An EoD-SQL query allows for the parameter description to be built into the SQL. This class parses the query and produces a plain SQL string (with prepared '?' placeholders for injected parameters), and then allows for extraction of the parameters from a Context object.
    Author:
    Jason Morris

    • Constructor Detail

      • Query

        public Query(String eodsql,
             Class<?>... parameterTypes)
      throws ParseException

        Create a new Query object. The given query string will be parsed, and errors will be reported. This constructor is to be considered "heavy weight", since it does some fairly detailed inspection of the parameters in order to validate the query string.

        For a lighter weight alternative use the getQuery(String, Class[]) method which makes use of a cache of Query objects (Query objects are immutable and therefore thread-safe). If Query objects are created on a per connection or per-request they can quickly become very expensive.

        Parameters:
        eodsql - the query string to be parsed
        parameterTypes - the types of the parameters that will be in the Context in the getParameter(Context, int) method
        Throws:
        ParseException - if the query string cannot be parsed or the parameter types cannot supply the values required by the query string
        See Also:
        getParameter(Context, int), Context.getParameters()

      • getParameter

        public Object getParameter(Context context,
                           int index)
        Extracts an indexed parameter from the specified Context object. The index is where the parameter was specified in the query-string, not within the Context.
        Parameters:
        context - the Context to extract the parameter from
        index - the index in the query string of the requested parameter (starting at 0).

      • getParameterCount

        public int getParameterCount()
        Returns the number of parameters that this query will need. This has no relation to the number of parameters passed to a method. A method may take one parameter, which is introspected by the query into any number of parameters. It could be the other way around as well.
        Returns:
        the number of parameters that can be fetched using getParameter(net.lemnik.eodsql.spi.Context, int)

      • validate

        public static void validate(String query,
                            Method method)

        A utility method to validate an EoD SQL query string. This method does nothing to validate the SQL, but does attempt to make sure all of the EoD SQL parameters are well formed and have matching parameters in the given method. It will also look to make sure that the properties or fields referenced in the query are visible.

        The advantage of this method is that it's a lot cheaper than allocating a new Query object.

        Parameters:
        query - the query string to validate
        method - the method with which the query is asociated

      • getQuery

        public static Query getQuery(String eodsql,
                             Class<?>... parameterTypes)
                      throws ParseException

        This is the preferred method for fetching a Query object. This method makes internal use of a SoftReference cache in order to avoid re-parsing commonly used queries. Any Query fetched from this method will be cached in memory and re-used if possible (and required).

        The parameters to this method are identical to the constructor.

        Parameters:
        eodsql - the query string to be parsed
        parameterTypes - the types of the parameters that will be in the Context in the getParameter(Context, int) method
        Returns:
        the Query object for the given query string and parameter types
        Throws:
        ParseException - if the query string cannot be parsed or the parameter types cannot supply the values required by the query string
        Since:
        2.1
